purpose: local directional probe for the shared g<=3 exact closure, positive-weight preprocessing path/workspace reuse, and directed-cut truncated potential-cone update
scope_warning: These are same-machine Windows MinGW direction checks, not Linux-server P1 results. Absolute times and ratios may differ on the submission server; the full 13-graph P1 matrix must be rerun there before any paper claim.

policy.comparison_unit: sum of solver-only query time over the listed fixed query range and frozen configuration
policy.required_semantics: weight and mask_vertex_states must match the latest-main binary query by query
policy.configuration_contract: g<=3 closure and positive-weight preprocessing are common to every legal configuration; potential cone is internal to the DirectedCut safe addition; no graph-name, empirical-g, timing, memory, or per-query mode switch is allowed

final_validation_candidate.post_timing_changes: No executable-source change: a source-review trial was fully reverted, the final source hashes equal the timed source hashes, and the source-identical Windows MinGW LTO validation rebuild passed 5/5 tests; documentation and this experiment record were then updated

accepted_changes.statement: For g<=3, OPT equals min_v sum_i d_i(v); before any enhancement realization, every legal configuration runs the same BootstrappedBounded DistanceRootInitialization package and closes immediately.
accepted_changes.contract_reason: This is a common mathematical base case, not an empirical group-count configuration switch.

accepted_changes.statement: Positive-weight graphs use the load-time minimum edge weight, sort only F query-terminal records, and avoid a per-query m-edge scan and n-sized component arrays; safe dense workspaces are reused inside their existing realization.
accepted_changes.contract_reason: Component cover is common. Workspace reuse changes only storage lifetime inside an already documented distance realization.

accepted_changes.statement: Residual capacity updates skip edges whose two capped potentials both equal the root cap and enumerate the same remaining support through the cheaper of sparse-cone adjacency and dense edge traversal.
accepted_changes.contract_reason: It preserves every potential, residual update, primal edge rule, and downstream state; it is internal to the existing DirectedCut addition.

accepted_changes.statement: The once-per-query dual build is kept out of PrepareProblem by a cross-compiler noinline boundary.
accepted_changes.contract_reason: This only isolates cold Enhanced machine code so that an unexecuted branch does not perturb Base instruction layout.

rejected_intermediate.description: The first cone candidate allowed IPO to inline the enlarged dual cold path into the shared preprocessing translation unit.
rejected_intermediate.decision: Rejected. The final noinline cold boundary removed this Base regression before acceptance.

final_panels.aggregation: median of two contemporaneous samples per binary

validation.configuration_exactness: 144 deterministic random instances with g=2..10 plus explicit all-configuration low-group closure and per-arc residual accounting PASS
validation.zero_weight_robustness: historical four-group witness regression and a 50000-vertex reverse-order zero-weight DSU chain PASS
validation.final_panel_answer_and_state_identity: PASS: every listed query matches the latest-main binary in objective weight and mask_vertex_states
validation.local_performance_gate: PASS: maximum final candidate/main panel ratio is the contemporaneous two-sample Orkut Base median ratio 1.020972, below the repository's existing 1.03 local-noise threshold

required_next_step: Build this branch with the formal Linux server toolchain, rerun the full P1 13-graph/8318-query matrix against PrunedDP++-Safe with the frozen 10000-second timeout, and diagnose any graph where PrunedDP++ still beats both ABHSS configurations in aggregate.
